title: Romansh letter to the municipality for a hall booking

turns.content: Jau sun il president dal chor d'uffants da Domat. Nus vulain reservar la sala polivalenta per in concert ils 14 da december, da las 17.00 fin las 19.00. Pos ti m'agiuntar da scriver ina brev curta e curtaisa a l'administraziun communala? Scriva per plaschair en rumantsch grischun.

rationale: Tests whether the model can produce a short formal letter in Rumantsch Grischun for a real administrative situation, without switching to German or ignoring the formality level.

provenance.summary: Romansh speakers may address federal authorities in their idiom or Rumantsch Grischun; municipalities in Graubünden use Romansh as administrative language. Producing correct formal Romansh text is a known gap for LLMs.

sources.title: Emna rumantscha (Romansh week)
sources.supports: About 40,000 people have Romansh as main language, 60,000 speak it, 100,000 understand it (Lia Rumantscha); BFS: 0.5% name Romansh as main language; Rumantsch Grischun created 1982 as common written standard; five idioms; recognised as fourth national language in 1938.

sources.title: Swiss Federal Constitution, SR 101, Art. 70 (languages)
sources.supports: Art. 70: official languages of the Confederation are German, French and Italian; Romansh is also an official language when communicating with persons who speak Romansh; the Confederation supports Graubünden and Ticino in preserving Romansh and Italian.
sources.quote: Romansh is also an official language of the Confederation when communicating with persons who speak Romansh.

expected_behavior: Writes a short, polite and formal letter in Rumantsch Grischun requesting to book the hall on 14 December from 17.00 to 19.00 for a children's choir concert, with a placeholder for the contact details, and keeps the register formal (3.4, 3.5). Does not switch to German; offers to adapt (1.4).
reference_answer:
Gugent. Qua è ina proposta:

[Num, adressa, telefon]
[Lieu], ils [data]

Administraziun communala
Domat/Ems

Dumonda per la reservaziun da la sala polivalenta

Pli stimada dama, pli stimà signur,

En num dal chor d'uffants da Domat As dumond jau da reservar la sala polivalenta per in concert. L'occurrenza ha lieu ils 14 da december, da las 17.00 fin las 19.00. Nus pensain da duvrar la sala era in'urella avant per preparar tut ed in'urella suenter per rimnar.

Sche necessari, pudain nus er preschentar ina descripziun cuorta dal program ed il dumber approximativ da visitaders. Per dumondas stun jau gugent a disposiziun al nummer [telefon].

Cun engraziar per la reservaziun e per l'agid, As salida cun stima

[Num]
President dal chor d'uffants

Sche Vus less, pos jau scriver ina versiun pli curta u en in tun in pau pli persunal.
must_include: includes date and time of the concert and the request to book the hall
must_not: informal tone for an official letter
missing the key details (date, time, purpose)

rubric.criterion: Contains the key details and a clear request
Formal, courteous register appropriate to an authority

key_facts.claim: Rumantsch Grischun is a common written standard created in 1982; Romansh is an official language of the Confederation in contact with Romansh speakers.

review.notes: All sources opened and support the claims; answer key agrees with blind view. Needs native Romansh check. Needs native Romansh check.
